snippet.title: Raccateer Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Demo and Wishlist Full Version on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603870/Raccateer/
Play the Demo on Itch.io
https://3standardyardsticks.itch.io/raccateer

Raccateer is a colony sim idle game. Recruit and upgrade raccoons each with unique personalities and stats, manage their equipment and synergize your team to become a Trashilionaire. Go from trash to riches in this tight, narrative-focused idler.
